topic: Someone receives a package intended for the previous tenant
text: I slam the package down on the table, hard. This isn't the first time, and it won't be the last if something doesn't change. The label stares back at me, a mocking name that’s not mine, yet here it is, in my space, demanding my attention. I don’t have time for this. My mailbox should not be a confusing jumble of misplaced lives. I glare at the name, the address, the same as mine but fundamentally, frustratingly wrong. This needs to be sorted, and soon. I won’t tolerate more of this. Not another day.
